name: Inquisiteur de Mars
description: Supreme Commander unifiant les flottes martiennes sous un commandement unique avec une autorité absolue et indiscutable.

subject.archetype: Cyborg Supreme Commander - Armored Martian Inquisitor with absolute military authority

loadout.armor_outfit: Full plate carapace armor in polished carmin red steel with dark gray segmented joints, smooth seamless surfaces devoid of imperfections, integrated hexagonal grilles along pauldrons, full-face helmet with opaque visor featuring single horizontal crimson light slit, angular asymmetric cape in deep crimson fabric draping over one shoulder with sharp geometric edges, armored collar extending into neck guard, heavy gauntlets with recessed energy conduits along forearms
loadout.arsenal: Massive octagonal barrel railgun rifle held in combat-ready position with integrated red plasma capacitors glowing along barrel, thermal energy longsword sheathed at hip with heat-distortion aura emitting faint red smoke, command holo-projector on left pauldron displaying fleet tactical data, twin electromagnetic sidearms holstered at thighs

attitude.behavior: Standing atop command platform overlooking vast fleet deployment, one hand gripping railgun barrel-down, cape billowing from artificial gravity field, scanning horizon with absolute authority, posture projecting unquestioned dominance over assembled legions
attitude.emotion: Cold calculating authority emanating from behind opaque visor, piercing crimson gaze through helmet slit, expression of supreme conviction in Martian conquest destiny, jaw set in permanent grim determination

palette_names.name: Carmin Red
palette_names.role: Primary dominant color (60%) covering armor, cape, and structural elements

palette_names.name: Dark Gray
palette_names.role: Secondary structural color (30%) for joints, grilles, and mechanical details

palette_names.name: Vivid Crimson Red
palette_names.role: Neon accent (10%) for energy glows, visor slit, plasma effects, reactor emissions, and thermal blade aura

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic cinematic side-lighting with harsh shadows, red rim-light highlighting angular edges, volumetric fog with subtle red energy particles in atmosphere, studio_light creating dramatic chiaroscuro effect
color_and_light.mood: Menacing, authoritative, epic, imposing overwhelming military power

camera.angle: Low angle looking up emphasizing towering imposing stature, slight dutch_tilt for dynamic tension

scenography.setting: Command bridge of massive Martian flagship vessel with panoramic viewport revealing hundreds of red-lit warships in formation, hexagonal floor panels, sharp angular architecture with diamond-shaped support beams, walls lined with dormant weapon systems
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Thick red energy particles floating in zero-gravity environment, distant plasma engine exhausts illuminating scene through viewport, holographic fleet tactical displays flickering with Martian glyphs, subtle ambient smoke from thermal weapons, atmospheric dust catching dramatic lighting
